Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej

Class CompileTelemetryListener

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.bluej.CompileTelemetryListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
public class CompileTelemetryListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
Listens for compilations the student starts and records their start, each error, and success or failure. Background compiles and warnings are ignored. Part of the Command pattern: this class is a client.
Author:
Anushka Dwarika
